title: The balance test: can you stand on one leg for 30 seconds?
caption: Can you stand on one leg for 30 seconds? Take the balance test, then do your level every day for two weeks: Kneeling Balance Reach, Reverse Lunge, Single-Leg Hip Hinge or Split Squat. Save this and retest.

overlays.text: Can you stand on one leg for 30 seconds? Try it, then swipe.

scenes.footer: Touch the wall if you need to. That ends the count. Use your lower side.

overlays.text: Stand near a wall, eyes open. Lift one foot and count the seconds. Then switch sides.

scenes.footer: Do this every day. Move on when all 8 feel steady.

overlays.text: Start here. Kneeling Balance Reach. 8 reps. On all fours, reach opposite arm and leg.

scenes.footer: Move on when all 6 feel steady on both sides.

overlays.text: Reverse Lunge. 6 each side. Step one foot back, lower the knee, stand up.

scenes.footer: Move on when all 6 happen without touching down.

overlays.text: Single-Leg Hip Hinge. 6 each side. Stand on one leg, hinge forward, stand tall.

scenes.footer: Move on when all 8 feel easy. Then put your back foot on a chair.

overlays.text: 30 felt easy? Split Squat. 8 each side. Feet staggered, lower down, push back up.

scenes.footer: Same wall, same count. Write down both sides.

overlays.text: Do your level every day. Take the balance test again in two weeks.

scenes.footer: Save this and retest in two weeks.

overlays.text: How many seconds, left and right?
